March: no captured payment, minus r3 2000 = -2000; failed p3 excluded.
April and May: declared-complete streams contain no eligible activity.
June: p4 30000 minus f4 900 = 29100; pending rp excluded.
Totals: 60000 - 6500 - 1850 = 51650; July and Orbit excluded independently.
